lines.zh: 白翅在绿荫里像一片纸。
lines.en: White wings look like paper in the green shade.
I fly slowly, wary of capture.
A thin black border rims my wings.
I fly along the bark.
My white wings throw the light back.
I cross the flowers without stopping.
I circle a while on high.

lines.zh: 影子太明显，我往阴影飞。
lines.en: My shadow betrays me; I dive into shade.
I avoid the places with webs.
My wings open and close, light as breath.

lines.zh: 我落在白花上，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I land on white flowers and vanish.
I drift on the air current.
I fly a stretch and double back.
White is rare in the jungle.
I avoid the brightest places.
A wingtip grazes a leaf.
Wings shut, I rest on a leaf vein.
White hides me among flowers.
My antennae slice the air.
I do not like long sun.
The underside of this leaf is cool.

lines.zh: 我躲在叶背，一点风也没有。
lines.en: Not a breath of wind under the leaf.
The black border is wearing.
I wait for softer light.
This white flower is like me.
Two soft wingbeats.
Dew hangs on the leaf tip.
Dew dries slowly off my wings.
You are dressed far too brightly.

lines.zh: 白色在你阴影里看得最清。
lines.en: White shows clearest in your shadow.
I rest behind your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你挥手，我就散成一片白。
lines.en: Swing your hand, and I scatter white.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸弄乱了我的翅。
lines.en: Your breath disturbs my wings.
Slow, but very light.

lines.zh: 我在你袖子上闻到花粉。
lines.en: There is pollen on your sleeve.
I circle once overhead.
I would rather not yield this route.
I land on your cuff.
A stain on the white.
I skid along the ground.
A small tear in my wing.
I hide in the flowers.
A crease appears in my wing.
I cannot shake the dirt off.
I lift, then settle.
The black border broke.
My wings are not crushed yet.
Do not step.
White flowers suit me.
Where is the nectar in this one?
I settle on the petal's edge.
Hold it steady and I will land.
This one is faint.
Too red. I look for white.
Red flowers draw too much attention.
I drink slowly.
I will save this one for tomorrow.
Thank you for not crushing it.
White picks up your dust.
The knock drags me against the ground.
A crease in my wing.
I lift, then settle.
You caught my wing edge.
Do not grab at white.
I slip behind a flower.
That startled me badly.
We passed each other.
I pause on your hat.
I look for a black-edged wing.
White with white stays hidden.
Eggs go on the leaf's veins.
I must take this slowly.
There is little white in this wood.
I circle looking for one like you.
I rest on a white flower.
This should not be hurried.
I drift away.

lines.zh: 今年不是时候，我飞走了。
lines.en: Not this season; I drift off.
Too heavy for me to lift.
One touch and I go.
This is not for me.
It is bigger than my wings.
I try twice and give up.
I cannot tell white from white.
I push it off the leaf.

lines.zh: 这个白得一点也不像我。
lines.en: This white is nothing like mine.
I tap it once with my feet.
No.
I retreat toward the white blooms.
Startled, I nearly drop into the water.
I can only go up.
White wings are hard to follow.
I flick behind a flower.
You will not catch me.
Slow, but I change direction.
I do not want to be pinned to paper.

lines.zh: 我从你的手臂下面穿过去。
lines.en: I slip under your arm.
One moment and I am gone.
I am outside your sight.
White shows only in the dark.
Your elbow moved.
I am under the leaf.
I move when the light shifts.
I wait for you to look away first.
I wait for your shadow to shift.
My wings make no sound.
You will not find the white one.

lines.zh: 我再等一次开合的时间。
lines.en: One more open-and-close of wings.
I touch you with a wing edge.
A little white dust falls.
That was light as a sigh.
I brush your earlobe.
All I can do is flee.
You slapped at nothing.
I retreat into white flowers.
I cannot hurt you.
I fold my wings and drop.
I skim low and dodge your hand.
White drifts out between leaves.
I settle on a flower first.
The light here is soft.
No one comes this deep.
I circle a white flower.
My wings have not gathered dust yet.
There is moisture in the air.
I hover to test the wind.
My white shadow is short.
I rise slowly.
The flame turns white to yellow.
I settle to the ground, weightless.

lines.zh: 白翅一沾水就贴在身上。
lines.en: Wet white wings cling to me.
The blast crumples the white.
A fine thorn punches my wing.

lines.zh: 咒光让我的白变得刺眼。
lines.en: Magic makes my white glare.
No flowers. I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 白光照白翅，什么都看不见。
lines.en: White on white — nothing to see.

lines.zh: 这里没有花，也没有颜色。
lines.en: No flowers, no color at all.
